title: Do Coverage and Mutation Scores of LLM-Generated Test Suites Correlate with Their Effectiveness? (Replicability Study)
venue: Proceedings of the ACM on software engineering.
datasets: Defects4J v3.0: 318 buggy/fixed focal methods across 17 projects; BugsInPy related-work only.
models: 11 models / 13 settings, Table 2; public outputs. Original model snapshots not pinned.
license: MIT main repo; see NOTICE for dependencies
input_setting: Generate tests from both buggy and fixed focal methods; F2P outcome uses fixed version as oracle.
reproduction_grade: B for analysis from included CSVs; conditional for end-to-end generation
concept_hook: Evidence that proxy metrics diverge from direct bug detection for buggy-code input; use direct F2P as outcome. Not an RCA/concept method.
limitation: No root-cause labels; no BugsInPy experiments; some plot cells transcribe values; provider snapshots not pinned.
